<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_GoodsShipping" name="Goods Shipping" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Shipping">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretary" name="Secretary">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_GoodsToShip</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Branch_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ClarifyShippingResponsibility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Size_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InviteLogisticCompanies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectLogisticCompany</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NormalPostShipment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Size_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WritePackageLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Insurance_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_LogisticsHead" name="Logistics Department Head">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeParcelInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouseman">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PackageGoods</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Ready_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PreparePickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_GoodsReadyForPickup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Branch_Split" name="Split shipping and packaging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Clarify</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Package</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShippingResponsibility" name="Clarify who will do the shipping">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Clarify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Clarify_SizeSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Size_Split" name="Amount size?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Clarify_SizeSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Large_Invite</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Small_Post</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Large_Invite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invite_Select</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" name="Select one logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invite_Select</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_SizeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPostShipment" name="Use normal post shipment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Small_Post</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Post_SizeMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Size_Merge" name="Shipping arrangement determined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_SizeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Post_SizeMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SizeMerge_Label</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WritePackageLabel" name="Write package label">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SizeMerge_Label</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Label_InsSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Split" name="Parcel insurance necessary?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Label_InsSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ins_Take</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ins_Skip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" name="Take parcel insurance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ins_Take</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Take_InsMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Merge" name="Insurance decision done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Take_InsMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ins_Skip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsMerge_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Package goods">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Package</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Package_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Shipping preparation and packaging ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsMerge_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Package_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Prepare</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by logistic company">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Prepare</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Prepare_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_GoodsReadyForPickup" name="Goods ready for pickup">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Prepare_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Gateway_Branch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Clarify" sourceRef="Gateway_Branch_Split" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShippingResponsibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Package" sourceRef="Gateway_Branch_Split" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Clarify_SizeSplit" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShippingResponsibility" targetRef="Gateway_Size_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Large_Invite" name="Large amounts" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Split" targetRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Small_Post" name="Small amounts" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Split" targetRef="Task_NormalPostShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invite_Select" sourceRef="Task_InviteLogisticCompanies" targetRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_SizeMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectLogisticCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Size_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Post_SizeMerge" sourceRef="Task_NormalPostShipment" targetRef="Gateway_Size_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SizeMerge_Label" sourceRef="Gateway_Size_Merge" targetRef="Task_WritePackageLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Label_InsSplit" sourceRef="Task_WritePackageLabel" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ins_Take" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ins_Skip" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Take_InsMerge" sourceRef="Task_TakeParcelInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Package_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_End" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_GoodsReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
